description: This source file defines the AdoNetGrainStorageProviderBuilder class which implements the IProviderBuilder interface to configure ADO.NET grain storage in an Orleans silo. The class reads configuration options such as connection strings, invariants, and serializers from a configuration section and applies these settings during the storage provider setup.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder to configure ADO.NET grain storage for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add ADO.NET grain storage by reading settings from the provided configuration section and applying them to the storage options.
